title: Innovation in Times of Uncertainty
content:
Uncertainty is a permanent feature of the innovation landscape — yet most product teams are structured for predictability. This talk, delivered in collaboration with InProduct, explores how to effectively manage product innovation when the environment is volatile and the path forward is unclear.

Key themes

  • Why traditional roadmaps break down under uncertainty, and what to do instead
  • How to maintain a clear innovation direction without false certainty
  • Practical techniques for keeping teams aligned and motivated when outcomes are unpredictable
  • The role of leadership in creating psychological safety for experimentation

About the talk

Delivered in collaboration with InProduct.

Speaker: Remko Vermeulen, VP & Head of Product
